Fitur: Σ diketahui dua populasi, Σ₁ = Σ₂
Skenario Pengujian: Positif: Uji khi-kuadrat μ₁ − μ₂ = δ₀ dengan satu Σ diketahui
Langkah Pengujian: 1. Impor hotelling 2 populasi independen.csv. 2. Analyze → General Linear Model → Multivariate. DV x1, x2, x3, x4; Fixed Factor(s): jk; Covariance Matrices: Equal (Pooled estimate of Σ). 3. Klik "Test Values (δ₀)"; isi 3, 2, 10, 1. 4. Centang "Population covariance matrix (Σ) known"; pilih "Σ₁ = Σ₂ = Σ (one matrix)"; isi Σ: x1 7, 6, 5, 5; x2 16, 8, 6; x3 29, 14; x4 22 → Continue. 5. Options: Simultaneous CI → Continue. 6. OK.
Hasil yang Diharapkan: Ringkasan di panel Covariance Matrices "δ₀ = [3, 2, 10, 1] · Σ known". Tabel "Chi-Square Test (Known Covariance Matrix)": Hypothesis "μ(jk = 1) − μ(jk = 2) = δ₀", Chi-Square 1.7971, df 4, Sig. 0.7730; catatan memuat "H₀: μ(jk = 1) − μ(jk = 2) = δ₀, δ₀ = [3, 2, 10, 1]. Σ₁ = Σ₂ = Σ is known (entered in Test Values (δ₀))" dan rumus dengan [(1/n₁ + 1/n₂)Σ]⁻¹. Tabel CI Σ diketahui, x4: Mean Difference 0.8125, Std. Error 1.1726, χ² −2.7994–4.4244, Bonferroni (z) −2.1163–3.7413 (skala data asli, δ₀ ditambahkan kembali). Nilai = R (K2-d). [Revisi R9 (2026-09-26): Ringkasan kini "δ₀ = [3, 2, 10, 1]; Σ known".]
Keterangan Iterasi 3: Matriks Σ berlabel x1–x4, sel bawah nonaktif. Ringkasan "δ₀ = [3, 2, 10, 1] · Σ known". χ² 1.7971, df 4, Sig. 0.7730; catatan memuat teks yang diharapkan dan rumus [(1/n₁ + 1/n₂)Σ]⁻¹. CI x4: 0.8125, 1.1726, χ² −2.7994–4.4244, Bonferroni (z) −2.1163–3.7413. 26 nilai tampil = R. Bukti BB-KF03-14-1 s.d. -6.
